measurementBoundary: source-derived static baseline; no user-visible effect is claimed

metrics.definition: attempt identity collides with reversible budget count
metrics.limitation: Source shape only; the contract test reproduces the collision dynamically.

metrics.definition: ambient charging layers present for one logical request
metrics.formula: count(files charging ambient tryRecordAttempt without explicit opt-in gate)
metrics.limitation: After TF-0730 only provider transport charges ambient requests; retryAsync only charges an explicitly supplied budget. Dynamic recovery is measured by model-fallback.loop-termination.test.ts.

metrics.definition: agent self-edit emits human provenance labels
metrics.limitation: Persist is retired, so these labels are unreachable today; this is a recovery gate.

metrics.definition: independent commit steps inside one logical memory update
metrics.formula: sum(step count) for self-edit and curation
metrics.limitation: Transaction boundaries are inherited from the persistence port; values are candidate windows, not observed corruption.

metrics.definition: status classes currently collapsed into valid=true
metrics.limitation: Classes only; actual provider behavior varies by API. The 12-scenario matrix is the behavioral gate.

metrics.definition: validation state dimensions exposed by the result type
metrics.formula: count(reachable, auth, protocol, model, rateLimited, ready)
metrics.limitation: Type-shape evidence; UI semantics are asserted by semantic-convergence-provider-validation-matrix.test.ts.

metrics.definition: validation requests sharing inference guarded policy
metrics.limitation: Source contract: both call sites import the shared resolver; behaviour is asserted by semantic-convergence-provider-network-parity.test.ts.
Source contract; probe coverage is measured as NET-3.

metrics.definition: validation probes carrying the total deadline signal
metrics.formula: count(models, responses, chat, anthropic probes with signal)
metrics.limitation: Static coverage of the four probe call sites; runtime abort behaviour is unit-tested.

metrics.definition: policy parity between validation and inference
metrics.limitation: Same resolver, same normalized fingerprint; behavioural matrix in semantic-convergence-provider-network-parity.test.ts.

metrics.definition: prompt mutation fields covered by an authority declaration
metrics.limitation: No producer-level declaration exists today; this counts the public field list.

metrics.definition: post-orchestrator additions outside the managed ledger
metrics.limitation: Counts code paths, not actual chars; the snapshot coverage test measures chars.
Seal is default-off; presence is not enforcement evidence.

metrics.definition: shared memory cache invalidated on write path
metrics.limitation: No write-path invalidation found; TTL is 30s.
Includes golden-run by design; the node decides adopt-or-retire.
Assumes every batch hits its ceiling; the total operation is capped by the caller deadline. No network measurement.

metrics.definition: embedding batches started after the total deadline
metrics.formula: 0 if the loop checks remaining budget before every batch
metrics.limitation: Source-shape only; the fake-clock test exercises the 100-text/13-batch path.

limitations: Metrics are source-derived; no provider request, E2E, or live user data was executed.
RETRY-2 counts layers, not a measured amplification ratio for one request.
MEM metrics are recovery gates because runtime.memory.persist is retired.
VALID-1/VALID-2 are static classifications; the 12-scenario matrix is the behavioral gate.
